checks: Valid-hash but invalid NPC schema is rejected before readiness; old library remains installed.
Valid-hash Story file with no objectives is rejected before archive readiness; the prior installed pack remains untouched.
Cancellation during staged writes rejects the import and publishes no partial library.

Injected IndexedDB QuotaExceededError after the first committed staging batch aborts the next transaction, cleans partial files and leaves the prior archive readable. This is failure injection, not physical disk exhaustion.
Injected quota failure in the Story edits transaction changes neither the durable library nor its live session summaries/definitions.
Native card-save failure after archive storage keeps embedded NPC/Lore and the old card reference intact.
Explicit native migration stores all base/selected-version/long-ability/Lore/Story fields before clearing embedded arrays and the native Story pack, retains presets and survives real server reload.
Update embedded archive retains the entire old card/ref on native HTTP 503; retry atomically saves the new reference and payload and preserves native presets.
An installed revision with a deliberately removed NPC index reports WORLD_PACK_STORAGE_INVALID; it does not read a payload or attempt automatic re-import.
